title: Federated Learning under Distributed Concept Drift
authors: Ellango Jothimurugesan, Kevin Hsieh, Jianyu Wang, Gauri Joshi, Phillip B. Gibbons
relevance: Key prior art on handling staggered concept drift in FL via dynamic clustering (FedDrift).
overlapping_features: Client-level concept drift detection using loss divergence
Dynamic model adaptation in non-stationary federated settings
Clustered global models to isolate drifting distributions
distinguishing_features: Lacks drift transience classification (transient vs persistent)
Does not use stateful client gating FSM
Does not employ drift-feature-aligned selective layer transmission
Does not maintain historical server-side drift episode memory

title: FedDriftGuard: Adaptive concept drift management with communication-efficient federated learning
relevance: Direct competitor combining drift detection, aggregation weighting, and gradient sparsification.
distinguishing_features: Lacks transience classification (does not separate temporary spikes from persistent shifts)
Does not completely suppress transient updates to prevent global model disruption
Does not utilize layer-group gradient divergence for selective parameter transmission
Aggregates based solely on instantaneous round drift rather than historical multi-episode resolution memory

title: FLARE: Dual-Scheduler Framework for Non-Stationary IoT Federated Learning
relevance: Addresses communication overhead in edge/IoT FL under drift using dual schedulers.
overlapping_features: Selective communication triggering based on drift metrics
distinguishing_features: Employs data-transfer fallbacks rather than strictly decentralized parameter adaptation
Does not formulate client lifecycle as a structured state machine with recovery states
No episode resolution quality metrics for server aggregation

title: FedConD: Continual Federated Learning with Concept Drift Adaptation
relevance: Addresses continual learning under drift by adjusting local regularizers.
overlapping_features: Client drift detection using historical performance variance
Adaptive local regularization to counter drift divergence
distinguishing_features: Focuses on local loss regularization rather than communication transmission gating
Transmits entire model parameters regardless of drift severity
Does not score clients based on joint drift transience and reliability

title: Method and system for managing model drift in distributed machine learning networks
authors: Assigned to International Business Machines Corp (IBM)
relevance: Covers systems for detecting data drift across distributed edge nodes and scheduling model retraining.
overlapping_features: Distributed drift monitoring across multiple client nodes
Scheduling updates based on performance divergence thresholds
distinguishing_features: Lacks client-level state machine gating transmission modes (STABLE vs TRANSIENT vs PERSISTENT)
Does not feature layer-selective gradient transmission based on layer divergence
Does not incorporate server-side multi-episode drift resolution memory into aggregation weighting

title: Guidelines for Examination of Computer Related Inventions (CRIs)
identifier: Office of the Controller General of Patents, Designs & Trade Marks, India
relevance: Governs Section 3(k) patentability of software/computer-related inventions in India.
overlapping_features: Analysis of technical effect, technical contribution, and hardware interaction
distinguishing_features: DriftGate demonstrates tangible technical effect on distributed systems: measurable bandwidth reduction, reduced network congestion, prevention of server aggregation degradation
